ns2:section.sectionText: This course focuses on the foundation and some recent advancements of high-dimensional statistics. The course will cover basic and advanced probability tools such as concentration inequalities, uniform laws of large numbers and high-dimensional central limit theorem, as well as their applications in non-asymptotic analysis of some high-dimensional models. A selection of modern topics, such as high-dimensional sampling, variational inference and optimal transport, will also be explored. Prerequisites: STAT 553 (or MATH 561), and STAT 511 (or STAT 510). Prior knowledge of optimization will also be very helpful. For Statistics course registration information: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration.
